newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds higher, look to Bonte auction.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds higher, look to Bonte auction.

text.p: Argentine bonds finished higher Monday in anticipation of Tuesday's auction of $750 million of five year Bonte Treasury bonds.
"People are waiting for the Bonte which could affect the market," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/4 at 92-7/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was $0.15 higher at 115.25.
Trade was quiet during most of the session, said traders, but late gains in U.S. markets boosted volume late in the day.
Traders predict a cut-off yield on the Bontes of between 8.75 percent and 9.0 percent.
Another trader said because the market has now gained in several consecutive sessions, some investors were waiting on the sidelines in anticipation of a correction as a buying opportunity.
In the money markets, call money rates rose to 5.78 percent from 5.53 percent.
